page.content:
Dissolved-salt content that helps set seawater density and circulation.

How Salinity connects

  • Topic: Thermohaline circulation — Salinity, with temperature, sets the density that drives the conveyor.
  • Item: CTD rosette — Ships measure salinity profiles with CTDs on rosette frames.

What is Salinity?

Salinity, measured from Challenger bottles to modern CTDs, is the other half of density with temperature — the reason ice, evaporation, and rivers steer the conveyor.

Key threads lead to Thermohaline circulation and CTD rosette.
